arithmetic: SymPy exact rank/nullspace/Matrix determinant plus Python rational arithmetic only; no floating-point hull or coverage computation.

coverage_certificate.facet: Every signed subset-form sum was tested exactly against all vertices. Equality sets of affine rank three are precisely the exposed 3-faces; their 370 cones cover the boundary of the convex ball up to lower-dimensional overlaps.
coverage_certificate.ridge: Within each affine 3-face, every vertex triple was sign-tested against all face vertices. The collected equality sets are exactly its supporting 2-faces. Each ridge is partitioned by its vertex centroid coned to its exact boundary edges.
coverage_certificate.vertex: All 455 form triples were tested with SymPy rank. A rank-three zero set gives a one-dimensional cell whose normalized ray is an exact boundary vertex; conversely every vertex has three independent zero forms, so this list is complete.
coverage_certificate.volume: The 3-face centroid coned to those ridge triangles partitions the face. Since the origin is strictly interior, coning every boundary 3-face to the origin partitions the ball up to measure-zero intersections. Each summand is abs(det(c3,c2,v_i,v_j))/4!.

quotient_ball: {x in R^4: 2 sum_{empty != S subset [4]} |sum_{j in S} x_j| <= 1}
